verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is explicitly designed to be self-hosted as a single binary with no external dependencies, runnable on Linux/macOS/Windows or containers, with documented install steps (curl/brew) and production guidance (reverse proxy, systemd, master key). Runtime probes confirm the full engine installs and runs locally with no account and performs real index/search operations, and community evidence corroborates production self-hosted deployments at scale (7M+ articles, 80M documents). Missing for 10: no independent audit of long-term self-hosted operational parity with cloud version, and some community reports note scaling/RAM unpredictability under heavy write load.
